messages:
Bea (Design): Flagging a couple things from the usability pass: the relevance inspector overlay covers the toolbar export button on 1366px screens. Quick screenshot attached. Can we avoid occluding primary actions?
Rui (Frontend): Repro'd. Overlay is absolutely positioned over the toolbar. Short-term fix: make inspector push content instead of overlaying or add a collapse chevron.
Liam (Product): We also have a regression: some customers reported vectors getting truncated in CSV exports. Need a stable repro + fix ASAP.
Tanya (ML): The truncation looks like client-side serialization hitting a textarea/innerText limit. Recommend switching to Blob streaming + server-side zip with manifest. NDJSON is a safer default for big arrays.
Bea (Design): Copy for the export modal: header "Export dataset"; subtext "Choose format and whether to include raw vectors (may be large)." Checkbox label: "Include raw vectors (may be very large)". Primary CT A: "Start export".
Eli (A11y): Accessibility nits: export modal must be role=dialog + aria-labelledby, focus trap, and announce the recommended format (aria-live) when estimate > threshold. Sticky actions must be tabbable.
Rui (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) Blob streaming for client-side download, 2) call /estimate-export-size before enabling full-vector export, 3) if estimate>50MB default to NDJSON and show warning modal.
Liam (Product): Product decision: default CSV for exports <=50MB; auto-suggest NDJSON when >50MB. Soft cap full-vector CSV to 15k rows for self-serve; enterprise can request override. Add a small size badge next to format selector.
Tanya (ML): Server: provide compressed size estimate and generate server-side ZIP containing _meta.json (dataset_id, rows, dim) + file. Also stream zip to avoid memory spikes.
Bea (Design): UX follow-ups: add a "Condensed rows" toggle in the table toolbar (text + shortcut), collapse per-row preview into chevron to save width, and move export into modal for large exports. Keyboard shortcut = Shift+E for export.
Eli (A11y): Also ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion for expand/collapse, and add text fallback for relevance deltas (e.g., "+0.12") so screen readers don't rely on color.
deploy-bot: Created ticket UI-5381: "Vectors inspector overlap + safe export flow (NDJSON, zip manifest, size estimate, a11y)" and linked mock + repro.
